questions.prompt: A single-acting cylinder is powered by compressed air in how many directions?
questions.explanation: A spring, gravity, or another force provides the return movement.

reviewCue.text: Review C209 Pneumatic Systems.pdf, slide 42. Look for Single-Acting Cylinders, slide 42.
reviewCue.excerpt:
SINGLE-ACTING CYLINDERS
FUNCTION
• THIS TYPE OF PNEUMATIC CYLINDER IS 
POWERED BY COMPRESSED AIR IN ONE 
DIRECTION ONLY.
• TO MOVE IN ANOTHER DIRECTION, 
ANOTHER FORCE SUCH AS GRAVITY OR A 
SPRING IS USED.
• THESE CYLINDERS ARE USED IN 
APPLICATIONS WHERE THE  WILL CAUSE IT 
TO RETURN OR, IF THE  IS LIGHT ENOUGH, A 
SPRING CAN BE USED TO RETURN THE ROD.

questions.prompt: Where is a pneumatic muffler normally fitted to reduce noise?
questions.explanation: A muffler or silencer reduces noise from exhausted air.

reviewCue.text: Review C209 Pneumatic Systems.pdf, slide 49. Look for Mufflers, slide 49.
reviewCue.excerpt:
BASIC MOTOR CIRCUITS
MUFFLERS
• AIR MOTORS, ESPECIALLY AT HIGH SPEEDS ARE 
CONSIDERABLY LOUDER THAN ELECTRICAL AND HYDRAULIC 
MOTORS.
• MUFFLER, OR SILENCERS ARE PLACED ON THE EXHAUST PORT 
OF THE DCV OR THE COMPONENT ITSELF TO REDUCE NOISE.
• REDUCES NOISE LEVELS IN THE SAME MANNER AS THE 
MUFFLER DOES IN AN AUTOMOBILE.

questions.prompt: Which valve is normally used to operate a single-acting cylinder?
questions.explanation: 3/2 DCV. The course explains: 3/2 PNEUMATIC DCV FUNCTION A 3-PORT DCV IS NORMALLY USED TO OPERATE A SINGLE-ACTING CYLINDER DESIGNED TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE FACT THAT A SINGLE-ACTING CYLINDER IS POWERED IN ONLY ONE DIRECTION. ALLOWS THE MACHINE OPERATOR TO POWER A CYLINDER IN ONE DIRECTION AND EXHAUST AIR TO RETURN. THE 3 PORT DCV IS HELD IN THE ENERGIZED POSITION BY THE OPERATOR

questions.prompt: Which actuator produces rotary motion from compressed air?
questions.explanation: Pneumatic motor. The course explains: MOTORS PNEUMATIC MOTOR AN ACTUATOR THAT CONVERTS COMPRESSED AIR INTO ROTARY MOTION IS A PNEUMATIC MOTOR. AN AIR MOTOR IS USED WHEN LOW FORCE, ROTARY OUTPUT IS NEEDED SUCH AS: PNEUMATIC DRILL MIXING MOTOR SMALL WINCHES

• AN AIR MOTOR IS USED WHEN LOW FORCE, ROTARY 
OUTPUT IS NEEDED SUCH AS:
